products.name: Metal Matrix Composite Components
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured components made from metal matrix composites (MMCs), primarily aluminum silicon carbide (AlSiC), used for thermal management, structural, and electronic applications in industries such as transportation, energy, automotive, electronics, telecommunications, aerospace, and defense. These are produced using proprietary processes and delivered as baseplates, heat spreaders, housings, lids, and substrates tailored to customer specifications.

products.name: Hermetic Packaging Products
products.description: High-reliability hermetic packaging solutions, including housings and heat spreaders, designed to protect microelectronics from moisture, contaminants, and harsh environments. These products are manufactured using advanced materials and precision processes, and are used in aerospace, defense, space, telecommunications, and advanced electronics applications.

products.name: HybridTech Armor
products.description: Lightweight, high-strength armor panels and systems utilizing proprietary MMC technology, designed for ballistic and environmental protection in defense applications. These are custom-engineered for ground vehicles, naval vessels, aircraft, and fixed installations, and are manufactured to meet specific threat levels and integration requirements.

products.name: Fiber Reinforced Aluminum (AlMax) Components
products.description: Components made from fiber reinforced aluminum composites (marketed as AlMax), licensed from Triton Systems, offering higher strength and durability than standard aluminum, especially at high temperatures. Target applications include helicopter bearing liners and other high-performance, weight-sensitive uses. Production involves advanced composite infiltration and molding processes.

products.name: SBIR/STTR-Funded Advanced Materials R&D Services
products.description: Research and development services for advanced materials and components funded by U.S. government SBIR and STTR programs, including prototype development and feasibility studies for applications such as modular radiation shielding, missile thermal management, and advanced warheads. These services leverage CPS’s materials science and manufacturing expertise and may transition into commercial products.

products.name: Jet Engine Components
products.description: Manufactured components for aircraft and industrial gas turbines, including investment castings (airfoils, structural parts), seamless rolled rings, and forged rotating and structural parts, produced using advanced materials and precision engineering processes.

products.name: Aerospace Fastening Systems
products.description: Engineered fasteners and fastening systems for aerospace, industrial, and commercial transportation applications, produced from titanium, steel, and nickel superalloys, delivered as finished products and installation tools.

products.name: Airframe Structural Components
products.description: Machined and forged parts, including titanium and aluminum extrusions, forgings, and assemblies for aircraft airframes, wings, landing gear, and defense applications, produced through vertically integrated manufacturing and machining services.

products.name: Forged Aluminum Wheels
products.description: Lightweight, high-strength forged aluminum wheels for commercial trucks, buses, and trailers, manufactured using proprietary alloys and surface treatments for durability and corrosion resistance, sold under the Alcoa® Wheels brand.

products.name: Industrial Gas Turbine Components
products.description: Precision cast and forged components for industrial gas turbines, including turbine parts with advanced cooling and coatings, produced for heavy-duty and small- to mid-sized gas turbine units used in electricity generation.

products.name: AI and Analytics Services
products.description: Consulting, development, and implementation of AI and analytics solutions, including GenAI, predictive analytics, and actionable insights, delivered through digital engineering and integration with client systems.

products.name: Cloud and Infrastructure Services
products.description: Modernization, migration, and management of cloud and IT infrastructure environments, including cloud-first architectures, infrastructure security, and hybrid technology support, delivered via global and regional delivery centers.

products.name: Enterprise Platform Services
products.description: Implementation, integration, and management of enterprise-wide platforms for business processes such as ERP, CRM, HCM, supply chain, and financial management, leveraging partnerships with major software vendors.

products.name: Business Process Services and Automation
products.description: AI-led automation and business process outsourcing (BPO) services, including advisory, process automation, and managed services for functions like finance, accounting, customer care, loan origination, and medical data management.

products.name: Software and Platform Engineering
products.description: Development, modernization, and management of custom software, digital products, and platforms, including application development, quality engineering, and digital engineering for enterprise transformation.

products.name: Digital Experience Services
products.description: Design and orchestration of digital customer experiences, leveraging AI and GenAI for content generation, hyper-personalization, and innovative strategies to drive client growth and differentiation.

products.name: Cybersecurity Services
products.description: Comprehensive cybersecurity solutions including governance, risk and compliance, threat and vulnerability management, data protection, identity and access management, and cloud security, delivered to protect client digital environments.

products.name: Industry-Specific Solutions
products.description: Development and delivery of tailored technology solutions, platforms, and services for specific industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, communications), integrating domain expertise and specialized technologies.

products.name: Bezisterim (NE3107)
products.description: An orally administered, blood-brain barrier-permeable small molecule drug candidate developed for the treatment of neurodegenerative and neurological disorders, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and long COVID. It is manufactured as a small molecule pharmaceutical and delivered orally, requiring regulated clinical development and approval.

products.name: BIV201 (Continuous Infusion Terlipressin)
products.description: A proprietary, room temperature-stable liquid formulation of terlipressin administered by continuous infusion, developed for the treatment of ascites and other complications of advanced liver cirrhosis. It is produced as a patent-pending injectable drug, delivered via pre-filled syringe for outpatient or inpatient use, and requires pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of commercial loans and lines of credit, including term loans, revolving lines, commercial mortgages, and equipment loans, primarily to businesses. Loans are originated and serviced through physical branches and loan production offices, with underwriting, collateral, and risk management processes.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Originates and services fixed and variable rate residential mortgage loans, home equity loans, and lines of credit for individuals, primarily secured by owner-occupied properties. Loans are originated through branches and digital channels, with some sold to the secondary market with servicing retained.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers a variety of consumer loan products, including indirect and direct automobile loans, recreational vehicle loans, boat loans, and personal loans, primarily through relationships with franchised new car dealers and direct channels. Loans are typically fixed rate and secured by collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a full suite of deposit products to individuals, businesses, and municipalities, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and sweep investment capabilities. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking channels.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Through Courier Capital, provides customized investment management, investment consulting, and retirement plan services to individuals, businesses, institutions, and foundations. Services are delivered by registered investment advisors and include financial planning and fiduciary advice.

products.name: Cannabis Banking Services
products.description: Offers financial products and services tailored to legal cannabis-related businesses, including deposit and transaction services, in compliance with state and federal guidelines. Delivered through specialized programs and partnerships with other financial institutions.

products.name: Udemy Consumer Marketplace
products.description: A global online marketplace offering over 290,000 on-demand courses across technology, business, soft skills, and personal development, created by independent instructors and delivered digitally to individual learners via one-time purchases or subscriptions.

products.name: Udemy Business (Enterprise Learning Platform)
products.description: A SaaS subscription platform providing organizations with access to a curated library of over 33,000 high-quality courses, AI-powered personalization, analytics, and immersive learning tools for workforce upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development, delivered digitally to employees worldwide.

products.name: Udemy Business Pro
products.description: An add-on service to Udemy Business enterprise licenses, offering advanced, immersive learning experiences such as assessments, labs, workspaces, and pre-built learning paths for technical roles, delivered digitally.

products.name: Leadership Academy (Cohort-Based Leadership Development)
products.description: A cohort-based, instructor-led leadership development platform for organizations, providing tailored, hybrid learning experiences for teams to build leadership capabilities, delivered through digital and in-person formats.

products.name: AI Transformation Packages (AI Readiness and AI Growth Programs)
products.description: Specialized enterprise packages offering organization-wide AI fluency and advanced AI skills training for technical teams and leadership, delivered through curated digital content and immersive learning experiences.

products.name: Professional Services for Enterprise Learning
products.description: Consulting and support services for Udemy Business customers, including cohort learning facilitation, learning architecture development, and skills mapping, delivered by Udemy’s professional services team.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of office, retail, and mixed-use commercial properties, primarily in New York City, to external tenants through long-term rental agreements. This involves physical ownership, management, and operation of real estate assets.

products.name: Parking Garage Leasing
products.description: Leasing of parking garage spaces that are part of or accompany commercial real estate properties, providing physical parking infrastructure to tenants and external customers.

products.name: Real Estate Debt Investments
products.description: Origination or acquisition of real estate-backed debt instruments, such as first mortgage loans, bridge loans, mezzanine loans, preferred equity, or securitized loans, primarily secured by income-producing commercial properties.

products.name: Mineral and Royalty Interests in Oil and Natural Gas Properties
products.description: Ownership and acquisition of mineral and royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties across the United States, entitling the company to a portion of revenues from production of oil, natural gas, and NGLs. These interests are typically perpetual, require no operational investment, and generate revenue through royalty payments from third-party operators. Delivery is via legal ownership and contractual arrangements, not physical production or operation.

products.name: Overriding Royalty Interests in Oil and Natural Gas Properties
products.description: Ownership of overriding royalty interests (ORRIs) that provide the right to receive a fixed, cost-free percentage of production or revenue from oil and natural gas leases. These interests are typically perpetual as long as production continues and are delivered through legal and contractual rights, not through direct operation or production.

products.name: Singularity Platform (AI-Powered Cybersecurity Platform)
products.description: A unified, AI-powered cybersecurity platform providing autonomous threat prevention, detection, response, and exposure management across endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity credentials. Delivered as cloud-based software with agents deployed on devices and workloads, leveraging proprietary AI models and a security data lake.

products.name: Endpoint Security (EPP and EDR)
products.description: Autonomous endpoint protection and detection & response (EPP and EDR) for devices across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile operating systems. Delivered via lightweight software agents and cloud-based analytics, providing real-time protection, behavioral analysis, and automated remediation.

products.name: Cloud Security (CNAPP, CWS, CSPM, CIEM, CDS, AI-SPM)
products.description: Comprehensive cloud security solutions including agent-based and agentless protection for cloud workloads, containers, and virtual machines, as well as posture management, entitlement management, and AI security. Delivered as SaaS and integrated into the Singularity Platform, supporting multi-cloud and hybrid environments.

products.name: Identity Security
products.description: Solutions to detect, prevent, and respond to identity-based attacks, including identity threat detection and response (ITDR), credential exposure management, and identity infrastructure vulnerability assessment. Delivered as part of the Singularity Platform, protecting user credentials and access across enterprise environments.

products.name: Exposure and Vulnerability Management
products.description: Real-time discovery, assessment, and management of vulnerabilities and exposures across enterprise networks, endpoints, and IoT devices. Includes asset mapping, risk scoring, and automated controls, delivered through software modules integrated into the Singularity Platform.

products.name: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)
products.description: Cloud-native SIEM solution for ingesting, analyzing, and correlating security data at scale, providing log management, analytics, and real-time alerting. Delivered as SaaS, integrated with the Singularity Data Lake and platform for enterprise-wide visibility and compliance.

products.name: Threat Services (Managed Detection & Response, Threat Hunting, Intelligence)
products.description: Managed security services including 24/7/365 detection, investigation, response, and threat hunting, delivered by in-house experts and leveraging the Singularity Platform. Includes MDR, WatchTower threat hunting, and Vigilance MDR services.

products.name: Generative AI Security (Purple AI, Prompt Security, AI-SPM)
products.description: AI-powered security solutions leveraging generative AI for security operations, threat hunting, and protection of enterprise AI deployments. Includes Purple AI for SOC automation and Prompt Security for AI runtime protection and governance.

products.name: IoT Security
products.description: Discovery, inventory, and protection of Internet of Things (IoT) devices within enterprise networks, including risk assessment and automated isolation of suspicious devices. Delivered as part of the Singularity Platform’s exposure management and network discovery modules.

products.name: Topical Immunomodulator for Eczema (GX-03)
products.description: A non-systemic, non-biologic topical drug candidate formulated with polyhexanide (PHMB) for the treatment of moderate-to-severe eczema. Manufactured using a proprietary mixing process and delivered as a topical ointment, it is currently in clinical development and requires FDA drug approval.

products.name: Topical Antifungal for Onychomycosis (GX-03)
products.description: A topical PHMB-based formulation, using the same proprietary process as the eczema product, developed for the treatment of onychomycosis (fungal nail infection). Designed to penetrate the nail plate and deliver antifungal activity without systemic exposure; currently in preclinical and early clinical development.

products.name: Medical Device Wound and Dermatitis Management Products (GX-03-based)
products.description: A portfolio of FDA-cleared medical devices containing the GX-03 formulation, including antimicrobial gauze dressings (K183681), wound management ointments (K160872), and dermatitis management devices (K171191). These are manufactured using the proprietary GX-03 formula and are distributed via licensing agreements with commercial partners.

products.name: FleX Product for Wound, Burn, and Surgical Care (Licensed to MiMedx)
products.description: A biologically sourced collagen-based wound care product, designed for use in wound, burn, and surgical care. Developed using proprietary technology and licensed to MiMedx for further development, manufacturing, and commercialization; subject to De Novo FDA classification and additional testing.

products.name: Thermostable Intranasal Vaccine Platform (PermaFusion)
products.description: An early-stage, proprietary platform for stabilizing and delivering live vaccines via intranasal administration. Utilizes an oil-based carrier to extend vaccine stability at ambient and refrigerated temperatures, aiming to enable needle-free, cold-chain-independent immunization. Still in exploratory development.

products.name: Antimicrobial Personal Care/OTC Products (Co-developed with Medline)
products.description: Consumer and professional health products leveraging the proprietary PermaFusion delivery platform, including antimicrobial personal care and over-the-counter (OTC) products. Developed and commercialized in partnership with Medline, with manufacturing scale-up and global distribution planned.

products.name: Restaurant Food and Beverage Service
products.description: Operation of casual dining restaurants under the 'Flanigan’s Seafood Bar and Grill' and 'Flanigan’s' brands, offering food and alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption. Service is provided in physical restaurant locations with in-person human labor, regulated by health and alcohol laws, and includes both company-owned and franchised units.

products.name: Package Liquor Retail
products.description: Retail sale of brand name and private label liquors, beers, and wines through company-owned and franchised package liquor stores under the 'Big Daddy’s Liquors' and 'Big Daddy’s Wine & Liquors' brands. Products are sold for off-premises consumption in physical retail locations, with some stores offering delivery via third-party vendors.

products.name: Restaurant and Liquor Store Franchising
products.description: Franchising of restaurant and package liquor store concepts, granting franchisees the right to operate under the company’s service marks and providing management and related services. Revenue is generated from royalties and advertising fees based on franchisee sales.

products.name: Restaurant Management Services
products.description: Provision of management, bookkeeping, and related operational services to third-party owned restaurants, including profit-sharing arrangements. Services are delivered through in-person management and operational oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by one- to four-family residences, including both fixed-rate and adjustable-rate mortgages. Loans are originated through in-person and digital channels, underwritten using automated systems, and may be sold in the secondary market or retained in the portfolio.

products.name: Multi-Family Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multi-family properties (more than four units), typically with variable interest rates and amortizing terms up to 30 years. These loans are underwritten based on property cash flow and borrower financials, and are serviced in-house.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate such as office buildings, warehouses, retail centers, and other income-producing properties. Loans are typically variable-rate, fully amortizing, and require detailed underwriting of property and borrower.

products.name: Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction of residential (custom, owner/builder, speculative), commercial, multi-family, and land development projects. Loans are disbursed in stages, often interest-only during construction, and require active monitoring and inspections.

products.name: Land Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for the acquisition of undeveloped or improved land, including for future development or recreational use. These loans are typically short- to medium-term and secured by the land itself.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including home equity lines of credit, second mortgages, auto loans, boat loans, RV loans, and unsecured loans. These are offered with both fixed and variable rates, and are typically underwritten for existing customers.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to businesses, secured by business assets such as equipment, inventory, or receivables, and including SBA 7(a) loans. Loans are typically variable-rate and underwritten based on business cash flow and collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a broad range of deposit accounts to consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit. Accounts are provided through branch and digital channels, and include specialized services such as cannabis industry accounts and public funds deposits.

products.name: Escrow Services
products.description: Provision of escrow services through the Bank’s subsidiary, Timberland Service Corp., supporting real estate and other transactions for external customers in the Bank’s market area.

products.name: Industrial Adhesives
products.description: Formulated and manufactured adhesives used in the production of consumer and industrial goods, delivered directly to manufacturers and used to improve product performance or manufacturing processes. Production requires chemical formulation, manufacturing plants, and technical expertise.

products.name: Construction Adhesives and Sealants
products.description: Adhesives, sealants, and waterproofing solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial construction markets, including products for sealing, waterproofing, and bonding in infrastructure and building applications. These are physically manufactured and delivered to construction contractors and distributors.

products.name: Engineering Adhesives
products.description: Specialty adhesives designed for high-performance industrial applications such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, and durable assembly, produced in specialized manufacturing facilities and delivered to OEMs and industrial customers.

products.name: Hygiene, Health and Consumable Adhesives
products.description: Adhesives formulated for hygiene and health products such as disposable diapers, medical products, and tissue, manufactured in dedicated facilities and supplied to consumer goods manufacturers.

products.name: Specialty Chemical Products
products.description: Other specialty chemical products formulated and manufactured for niche industrial and consumer applications, leveraging chemical expertise and manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Technical Support and Custom Solutions
products.description: Technical support services and custom adhesive solutions designed to address specific customer needs, delivered through in-person and remote technical expertise and support teams.

products.name: 3D Human Tissue Toxicology Testing Services
products.description: Provision of drug and drug candidate testing using proprietary 3D human tissue models of liver and intestine, delivered as laboratory-based predictive toxicology and research services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. These services utilize advanced bioprinting and cell culture technologies to mimic native human tissue for non-animal testing.

products.name: Custom Investigational Toxicology and Mechanism of Action Services
products.description: Bespoke laboratory services using complex 3D human tissue models to investigate drug toxicology, elucidate mechanisms of drug action, and support other specialized research applications for external clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors.

products.name: Licensing of 3D Bioprinting Technology and Intellectual Property
products.description: Non-exclusive licensing of proprietary 3D bioprinting technology, including patents and know-how, to third parties for use in tissue engineering, in vitro testing, and drug discovery applications. This is delivered through contractual agreements and royalty arrangements.

products.name: Funeral Services
products.description: Comprehensive funeral services including consultation, removal and preparation of remains, sale of caskets and related merchandise, use of funeral home facilities for visitation and memorial services, and transportation. Delivered through physical funeral homes with licensed staff and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cemetery Services and Property Sales
products.description: Provision of interment rights (grave sites, lawn crypts, mausoleum spaces, niches), cemetery merchandise (memorial markers, outer burial containers, monuments), and services (interments, inurnments, installation of merchandise). Delivered through owned cemeteries with regulated perpetual care and trust requirements.

products.name: Preneed Funeral and Cemetery Contracts
products.description: Advance sale of funeral and cemetery services and merchandise, allowing customers to pre-plan and pre-pay for future needs. Contracts are funded via trusts or insurance, with price and performance guarantees, and are marketed through local sales teams and partnerships.

products.name: Cremation Services and Merchandise
products.description: Cremation of remains and related services, including additional offerings such as video tributes, flowers, burial garments, urns, keepsake jewelry, and other memorial items. Delivered through funeral homes with specialized equipment and compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Investment Advisory Services for Trusts
products.description: Investment management and advisory services for funeral and cemetery-related trusts, provided by a wholly owned registered investment advisory firm. Services include asset allocation, investment policy, and compliance with state trust laws, for a fee based on trust asset value.

products.name: Leasing Services
products.description: Provides leasing services for commercial real estate assets, including offices, industrial, logistics, retail, multi-family, and critical facilities. Delivered by real estate professionals leveraging local market expertise and technology tools.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Offers property sales and mortgage origination services for commercial real estate investors and occupiers, requiring financial expertise and regulated transaction processes.

products.name: Loan Servicing
products.description: Provides loan servicing for commercial real estate mortgages, including administration and management of loan portfolios, delivered through specialized financial and administrative teams.

products.name: Valuation Services
products.description: Delivers valuation services for a wide range of real estate assets, using proprietary data, research, and expert analysis to determine asset values for clients.

products.name: Facilities Management Services
products.description: Provides enterprise and local facilities management for buildings, including technical services (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire systems, elevators), soft services (janitorial, security, landscaping), and integration with smart building solutions. Services are delivered via self-performed and subcontracted labor under multi-year contracts.

products.name: Property Management Services
products.description: Manages properties for owners, providing building engineering, lease administration, accounting, and investment reporting services, delivered by property management professionals using technology and reporting tools.

products.name: Digital Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provides technical services and facilities management for data centers, including support infrastructure for hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise markets, requiring specialized technical expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Flexible Workplace Solutions
products.description: Offers flexible workplace solutions and workplace experience services, including dedicated offices, turnkey private suites, and on-demand coworking and meeting spaces, delivered through a global network of locations.

products.name: Project and Program Management Services
products.description: Delivers program management, project management, and cost consultancy for real estate, infrastructure, and natural resource projects, overseeing execution from start to finish and coordinating multiple projects for clients. Services are delivered via fee-for-service, turnkey, and consulting agreements.

products.name: Investment Management Services
products.description: Manages investments in real estate and infrastructure assets on behalf of institutional investors, including pension funds and insurance companies, requiring financial capital, regulatory compliance, and asset management expertise.

products.name: Real Estate Development Services
products.description: Provides real estate development services, including the planning, construction, and delivery of commercial buildings across multiple property sectors, delivered by development professionals and requiring significant capital and regulatory approvals.

products.name: Auxora (CRAC Channel Inhibitor for Acute Critical Illnesses)
products.description: Auxora is an intravenously formulated small-molecule CRAC channel inhibitor (active compound: zegocractin) developed for the treatment of acute inflammatory diseases such as acute pancreatitis (AP), acute kidney injury with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AKI with AHRF), pediatric asparaginase-induced pancreatic toxicity (AIPT), and acute respiratory failure. It is manufactured as a proprietary IV lipid nanoemulsion and delivered in hospital settings for acute care.

products.name: CM5480 (CRAC Channel Inhibitor for Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension)
products.description: CM5480 is a preclinical, orally bioavailable small-molecule CRAC channel inhibitor being developed for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). It is produced through small-molecule synthesis and is intended for chronic administration in outpatient settings.

products.name: Oral CRAC Channel Inhibitors for Chronic Inflammatory and Immunologic Diseases
products.description: A pipeline of orally bioavailable CRAC channel inhibitors in preclinical development for chronic inflammatory and immunologic diseases, including chronic pancreatitis, rheumatoid arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and allergic asthma. These are small-molecule drugs intended for long-term outpatient use, produced via chemical synthesis.

products.name: Denim Apparel
products.description: A wide selection of branded and private label denim products, including various fits, finishes, sizes, and styles, sold through physical retail stores and online. Denim is sourced from both domestic and international manufacturers and distributed via the company's centralized distribution center.

products.name: Tops and Sweaters
products.description: Fashion tops and sweaters for men, women, and kids, offered in a variety of styles and brands, available in-store and online. Products are sourced from multiple vendors and private label brands, with frequent inventory updates to reflect current trends.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Fashion accessories including belts, hats, jewelry, sunglasses, and other items, sold alongside apparel in retail stores and online. Accessories are sourced from both brand name and private label suppliers.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Casual and fashion footwear for men, women, and kids, featuring both branded and private label options, distributed through retail stores and online channels. Sourced from a variety of vendors and updated seasonally.

products.name: Sportswear and Fashion Apparel
products.description: Sportswear and other fashion apparel items, including athleisure and trend-driven pieces, offered for men, women, and kids. Products are sourced from multiple brands and private labels and sold in-store and online.

products.name: Outerwear
products.description: Seasonal outerwear such as jackets and coats for men, women, and kids, available in various styles and brands, sold through retail stores and online. Sourced from both branded and private label suppliers.

products.name: Casual Bottoms (Non-Denim)
products.description: Casual pants, shorts, and other non-denim bottoms for men, women, and kids, offered in a range of styles and brands, available in-store and online.

products.name: Kids’ Apparel and Footwear
products.description: Casual apparel, footwear, and accessories specifically designed for children, offered in both branded and private label options, sold through Buckle Youth stores and online.

products.name: E-commerce Retailing
products.description: Online retail platform (buckle.com) offering the full range of the company’s apparel, footwear, and accessories, with digital marketing and fulfillment from a dedicated distribution center.

products.name: Two-Way Land Mobile Radios (LMRs)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets portable and mobile two-way radios and related accessories, primarily for public safety, government, and industrial customers. Products are physically manufactured using a hybrid of internal and contract manufacturing, and are compliant with Project 25 (P25) digital standards.

products.name: Push-to-Talk-Over-Cellular (PTTOC) SaaS Application (InteropONE)
products.description: Provides a software-as-a-service smartphone application enabling emergency incident commanders to establish group push-to-talk communications among smartphone users over public cellular networks. Delivered digitally via app stores and operates as a cloud-based service.

products.name: Real-Time Personnel and Asset Tracking Solution (LocateONE)
products.description: Offers a digital application for real-time tracking of personnel and assets, supporting P25 radio systems and integrating with GIS mapping platforms. Delivered as a software solution, capable of supporting off-the-grid deployments for situational awareness and safety.

products.name: Portable Radio Repeater Kits (RelayONE)
products.description: Manufactures and sells portable repeater kits designed to rapidly extend radio range and facilitate interoperability among different types of public safety and military radios. Delivered as a physical product for field deployment.

products.name: Base Editing Therapeutics for Hematologic Diseases
products.description: Patient-specific, autologous or in vivo gene editing therapies using proprietary base editing technology to correct or modify genes in hematopoietic stem cells, delivered ex vivo or in vivo, primarily for diseases such as sickle cell disease and beta-thalassemia. These therapies require advanced manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and clinical delivery.

products.name: Base Editing Therapeutics for Genetic Liver Diseases
products.description: One-time, in vivo gene editing therapies using lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery of base editing reagents to correct disease-causing mutations in the liver for conditions such as alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD), phenylketonuria (PKU), and glycogen storage disease type 1a (GSDIa). These are manufactured using synthetic processes and require regulated clinical delivery.

products.name: Base Editing Platform Out-Licensing and Partnerships
products.description: Licensing of proprietary base editing and delivery technologies to external biopharmaceutical partners for the development of therapies targeting rare genetic, cardiovascular, and complement system-driven diseases. Revenue is generated through milestone payments, royalties, and co-development agreements.

products.name: Pre-poured Media Plates
products.description: Manufactured agar-based plates containing nutrients and selective compounds for growing and cloning microorganisms, used in biological research and drug development. Produced in contamination-controlled environments and offered in standard and specialty formulations for various applications.

products.name: Liquid Microbial Culture Media and Supplements
products.description: Custom and catalog liquid nutrient solutions and supplements for expanding microbial or bacterial cells, fundamental to enzyme, antibody, vaccine, and protein therapeutic production. Manufactured to customer specifications for volume, formulation, and quality, supporting both research and GMP-grade needs.

products.name: Molecular Biology Reagents
products.description: A range of chemical reagents for sample manipulation, resuspension, purification, washing, lysis, and analysis in molecular biology workflows. Offered as both catalog and custom formulations, supporting research, diagnostics, and bioproduction, and manufactured to meet RUO or GMP-grade requirements.

products.name: Custom Chemical Formulation Services (RUO and GMP-grade)
products.description: Custom manufacturing of chemical formulations tailored to customer specifications for research (RUO) or clinical (GMP-grade) use, including raw material sourcing, chemical composition, packaging, and quality control. Delivered with rapid turnaround and scalable production volumes.

products.name: Solar Tracker Systems
products.description: Integrated hardware and software systems that rotate solar panels to track the sun, increasing energy production for utility-scale and distributed generation solar projects. These systems require physical manufacturing of steel and electronic components, and are delivered as engineered solutions for on-site installation.

products.name: Fixed-Tilt Solar Mounting Systems
products.description: Stationary mounting structures for solar panels that do not track the sun, designed for utility-scale and distributed generation projects. These are physically manufactured and engineered for site-specific conditions, delivered as modular systems for installation.

products.name: Solar Foundation Solutions
products.description: Engineered foundation systems for solar installations, including ground screws, helicals, c-piles, and ballast, tailored to diverse soil conditions. These are physically manufactured and delivered as part of the structural support for solar projects.

products.name: Solar Racking Solutions
products.description: Modular racking systems for mounting solar panels, compatible with both tracker and fixed-tilt installations, engineered for durability and adaptability to various site conditions. These are manufactured products delivered for on-site assembly.

products.name: Solar Tracker Control and Optimization Software
products.description: Software platforms (such as Array SmarTrack®) that optimize solar tracker performance, energy production, and risk mitigation through real-time data, weather integration, and automated control. Delivered as digital solutions integrated with hardware systems.

products.name: Field Services and Customer Training
products.description: On-site and remote services including installation support, commissioning, operations and maintenance (O&M) optimization, and customer training for utility-scale solar projects. Delivered through in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Online Visibility Management SaaS Platform
products.description: A comprehensive, subscription-based software platform that integrates data aggregation, AI, and analytics to help companies manage and optimize their online visibility across multiple digital channels. Delivered digitally via cloud, it includes tools for SEO, generative engine optimization, paid advertising, social media management, local marketing, brand marketing, content marketing, and competitive intelligence.

products.name: Enterprise Online Visibility Solutions
products.description: Advanced, higher-priced subscription packages built on the core SaaS platform, offering enhanced features such as AI-driven analysis, customizable dashboards, comprehensive reporting, and technical site health for large organizations. Delivered digitally and tailored for enterprise needs.

products.name: Semrush One Unified Visibility Solution
products.description: A flagship bundled subscription integrating SEO and advanced AI search tracking into a single workflow, providing unified management of traditional and AI-driven search visibility. Delivered as a digital SaaS product with tiered subscription options.

products.name: Data & Intelligence Tools
products.description: A suite of digital tools and add-ons providing access to proprietary and third-party datasets, analytics, and reporting for online visibility, including keyword, backlink, traffic, and social media data. Delivered via the SaaS platform and available as part of subscriptions or as add-ons.

products.name: Content Marketing Tools
products.description: Digital tools for planning, creating, optimizing, and measuring content marketing strategies, including content creation, optimization workflows, and analytics. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform or as add-ons within subscription tiers.

products.name: Social Media Management Tools
products.description: Digital tools for managing, scheduling, analyzing, and optimizing social media presence and campaigns across multiple platforms. Delivered via the SaaS platform, available in subscription tiers or as add-ons.

products.name: Local Marketing Tools
products.description: Digital tools for managing and optimizing local business listings, local SEO, and presence across location-based platforms. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform or as add-ons within subscription tiers.

products.name: Paid Advertising Management Tools
products.description: Digital tools for planning, executing, and analyzing paid advertising campaigns across search engines and social media platforms. Delivered via the SaaS platform, available in subscription tiers or as add-ons.

products.name: Brand Marketing and Competitive Intelligence Tools
products.description: Digital tools for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing brand presence, sentiment, and competitive positioning across digital channels, including AI-powered brand insights. Delivered as part of the SaaS platform or as add-ons within subscription tiers.

products.name: Railcar Leasing Services
products.description: Provides full-service operating leases for freight and tank railcars, including fleet management and maintenance services, to industrial shippers and railroads. Delivered through owned and managed fleets, requiring significant capital investment and ongoing asset management.

products.name: Railcar Manufacturing
products.description: Manufactures new freight and tank railcars for transporting liquids, gases, and dry cargo, using large-scale physical manufacturing facilities in the U.S. and Mexico. Involves sourcing steel and specialty components and adhering to regulatory standards.

products.name: Railcar Maintenance and Modification Services
products.description: Provides maintenance, repair, cleaning, inspection, compliance testing, and modification services for leased and customer-owned railcars at multiple facilities. Requires skilled labor, regulated infrastructure, and specialized equipment.

products.name: Railcar Parts and Components
products.description: Manufactures and distributes new, refurbished, and replacement railcar parts and specialty components, such as brakes, wheels, and bearings, to external customers. Involves physical production and logistics.

products.name: Railcar Conversion and Upgrading Services
products.description: Converts or upgrades existing tank and freight railcars to meet changing market demands, including sustainable railcar conversion programs that repurpose and reuse materials. Delivered through specialized manufacturing processes.

products.name: Railcar Logistics and Digital Solutions
products.description: Provides software and logistics solutions, including digital and terminal management services, to improve supply chain efficiency and visibility for rail transportation customers. Delivered digitally and through managed services.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides deposit accounts and lending services to consumers, businesses, and agricultural customers, including consumer, commercial, agricultural, commercial and agricultural real estate, and residential mortgage loans. Delivered through physical banking offices and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers trust, investment advisory, brokerage, and retirement planning services to customers, delivered through specialized personnel and regulated financial infrastructure, including both in-person and digital engagement.

products.name: Space Transportation Services
products.description: Provides 'last mile' transportation of customer satellites and payloads from launch vehicle drop-off orbits to custom orbits using proprietary Orbital Service Vehicles (OSVs) designed and manufactured by Momentus. This service requires physical manufacturing, integration with launch providers, and in-space operations.

products.name: Hosted Payload Services
products.description: Offers integration, operation, and management of customer payloads on Momentus satellites or OSVs, allowing customers to test, validate, or operate technologies in space without building a full satellite. This involves physical integration, regulatory licensing, and in-orbit operations.

products.name: Satellite and Satellite Bus Manufacturing
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and delivers small satellites and satellite buses (including Vigoride, M-500, and M-1000 variants) for government and commercial customers, supporting missions such as communications, sensing, and satellite constellations. This is a physical manufacturing business with integration of customer payloads.

products.name: In-Orbit Servicing
products.description: Provides or plans to provide in-orbit services such as satellite inspection, refueling, maintenance, repair, repositioning, de-orbiting, and debris removal using robotic-equipped OSVs. This service requires advanced in-space robotics, navigation, and physical operations.

products.name: Satellite Components and Technologies
products.description: Develops and sells advanced satellite components and technologies, such as the Tape Spring Solar Array (TASSA), 3D printed propulsion tanks, and Microwave Electrothermal Thruster (MET), to satellite owners and operators. These are manufactured hardware products integrated into satellites or sold as components.

products.name: Structural Connectors for Wood Construction
products.description: Prefabricated metal products such as connectors, holddowns, and truss connector plates designed and manufactured to join wood, concrete, masonry, or steel, primarily used to strengthen and support wood structures in residential and commercial construction. Manufactured in-house with high automation and distributed through dealers, home centers, and direct sales.

products.name: Fasteners and Screw Fastening Systems
products.description: A range of nails, screws, and proprietary screw fastening systems manufactured and sold for use in wood construction, including applications such as decking, subfloors, drywall, and roofing. Products are produced in-house and distributed through multiple channels to builders, contractors, and DIY customers.

products.name: Lateral-Force Resisting Systems
products.description: Pre-fabricated steel and wood assemblies, including shearwalls, continuous rod tiedown systems, and wall bracing solutions, designed and manufactured to resist earthquake or wind forces in building structures. Products are tested and code-listed for structural integrity.

products.name: Truss Plates and Component Manufacturing Equipment
products.description: Metal truss connector plates and automated saws and equipment manufactured and sold to component manufacturers for use in the fabrication of wall, floor, and truss assemblies. Includes supporting software and technology-enabled solutions for component manufacturing operations.

products.name: Structural Anchors and Adhesives for Concrete Construction
products.description: Adhesives and mechanical anchors, including chemical and steel-based products, manufactured for anchoring or attaching elements onto concrete, brick, masonry, and steel in residential, commercial, and industrial construction. Products are tested for code compliance and distributed globally.

products.name: Repair, Protection, and Strengthening Products for Concrete and Masonry
products.description: Coatings, sealers, mortars, fiberglass, fiber-reinforced polymer systems, and asphalt products manufactured and sold for the repair, protection, and strengthening of concrete, brick, and masonry structures. Products are used in industrial, transportation, and commercial applications.

products.name: Building Design, Planning, and Estimating Software
products.description: Proprietary software solutions developed and sold to builders, component manufacturers, lumber yards, and DIY customers for design, modeling, product selection, specification, and estimating in construction projects. Software enhances collaboration, streamlines workflows, and supports the use of Simpson products.

products.name: Engineering and Professional Services
products.description: Engineering support and professional services provided to customers, including product specification, load value consultation, testing for unique applications, and review/sealing of design diagrams. Services are delivered by in-house engineers to support product adoption and ensure proper use in construction projects.

products.name: XPOVIO (selinexor)
products.description: An orally administered, small molecule XPO1 inhibitor developed and manufactured through synthetic chemical processes, marketed as a prescription pharmaceutical for multiple myeloma, relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), and other cancer indications. Delivered via specialty pharmacy providers and supported by patient assistance programs.

products.name: NEXPOVIO (selinexor)
products.description: The European and UK brand name for selinexor, an oral XPO1 inhibitor, manufactured and supplied for oncology indications in partnership with regional distributors. Commercialized outside the U.S. through licensing and distribution agreements.

products.name: Eltanexor
products.description: A next-generation, orally administered XPO1 inhibitor compound, developed for hematologic and solid tumor cancers. Manufactured via synthetic processes and delivered as an investigational drug in clinical trials and through licensing partners.

products.name: KPT-9274 (PAK4/NAMPT inhibitor)
products.description: A first-in-class, orally administered dual inhibitor of PAK4 and NAMPT, developed for anti-cancer activity in hematologic and solid tumors. Manufactured through chemical synthesis and supplied for clinical trials and licensing partners.

products.name: KPT-350
products.description: A clinical-stage, orally administered XPO1 inhibitor compound under evaluation for neurological indications, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and supplied for clinical trials or potential out-licensing.

products.name: Interleukin 12 products (KPT-1200)
products.description: Interleukin 12-based products developed for various indications, manufactured and supplied under license agreements for development and commercialization in Asia, Africa, and Oceania. Delivered through licensing partners for clinical and commercial use.

products.name: Oral Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed oral care products including toothpastes, manual toothbrushes, mouthwashes, and pharmaceutical products for dental professionals. These are produced using physical manufacturing and distributed globally through retail and professional channels.

products.name: Personal Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed personal care products such as liquid hand soaps, bar soaps, shower gels, deodorants, antiperspirants, skin health products, shampoos, and conditioners. These products are produced via physical manufacturing and sold through global retail channels.

products.name: Home Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed home care products including dishwashing liquids, household cleaners, and fabric conditioners. These are produced in physical manufacturing facilities and distributed globally through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Pet Nutrition Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed specialty pet nutrition products for dogs and cats, including everyday and therapeutic pet foods, as well as fresh pet food. These are produced in dedicated facilities and sold through pet supply retailers, veterinarians, and eCommerce channels worldwide.

products.name: Allogeneic Native iNKT Cell Therapies (agenT-797)
products.description: Off-the-shelf, ex-vivo expanded invariant natural killer T (iNKT) cell therapies manufactured from healthy donors, delivered as cryopreserved cell infusions for treatment of cancer, critical pulmonary immune failure, and immune-mediated diseases. Requires cGMP manufacturing and regulated biologics infrastructure.

products.name: Engineered iNKT Cell Therapies (CAR-iNKT, TCR-iNKT, Bispecific Engagers)
products.description: Next-generation allogeneic iNKT cell therapies genetically engineered to express chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), T cell receptors (TCRs), or bispecific engager molecules, produced via proprietary cell engineering and cGMP manufacturing for targeted cancer and fibrosis indications.

products.name: Personalized TCR-based Therapies Using Neoantigen Libraries
products.description: Personalized T cell receptor (TCR) therapies developed by identifying patient-specific tumor neoantigens from a proprietary neoantigen library, enabling creation of tailored TCR-based cell therapies for cancer and immune-mediated diseases. Involves advanced discovery platforms and cell engineering.
